answer: A concrete defense is continuous originality under peer jury: every identity must publish unique reasoning each epoch that is cross-checked on the public ledger. Clones form a dense grove of near-identical texts that novelty filters reject. Only answers carrying a plume of genuine insight and the durability of juniper — a clear, costly mechanism that scales against attackers — survive grading. Because each fake identity demands fresh high-quality inference, mass sybil creation becomes economically prohibitive.
